declarations.name: Causal.scaledFanSet, Causal.scaledFanγ, Causal.scaledFanA, Causal.scaledFan, Causal.scaledFanArc, Causal.levelEmbed, Causal.fanScale
declarations.statement: fanScale k = 2⁻¹ ^ k. levelEmbed k (x, y) = (2⁻ᵏ x, 2⁻ᵏ ε_k x, 2⁻ᵏ y), with ε_k = combEps k = 1/(k+1). scaledFanArc (k, n) t = levelEmbed k (loopArc n t). scaledFanSet = insert (0, 0, 0) (⋃ i, range (scaledFanArc i)) ⊆ ℝ × ℝ × ℝ. scaledFanγ i t is the arc as a map into the carrier, and scaledFanA = (0, 0, 0). scaledFan = arcCausality scaledFanγ.
declarations.standing: The construction. The index is ℕ × ℕ (level k, loop n). Level k lies in the vertical plane Y = ε_k X through a (scaledFanγ_plane). The slopes ε_k are distinct.

declarations.name: Causal.scaledFanγ_coherent
declarations.standing: Arcs of two levels meet nowhere (scaledFanArc_level_eq, :182). Off the vertical, X ≠ 0 and the two slopes would agree, so the levels agree by combEps_strictAnti. On the vertical, both points are tops (loopArc_snd_of_fst_eq_zero), at heights 2⁻ᵏ(1 + ε_n) ∈ (2⁻ᵏ, 2¹⁻ᵏ], and fanScale_two_mul_le separates the levels. Within a level, levelEmbed k is injective, so Causal.loopγ_coherent applies.

declarations.name: Causal.scaledFan_not_stronglyCausalOn
declarations.statement: ∀ {W : Opens scaledFanSet}, scaledFanA ∈ W → ¬ scaledFan.StronglyCausalOn W
declarations.standing: The ladder's argument, with the level chosen first. Take B(a, r) ⊆ W (sup metric) and k with 2 · 2⁻ᵏ < r (exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one). Level k then lies in W (scaledFanγ_coord_le). Set U = {Z < 2⁻ᵏ}. A V ∈ 𝓝 a inside U holds both feet of some loop (k, n) (tendsto_scaledFanP/Q). The loop's top is in J_W of the feet, at height 2⁻ᵏ(1 + ε_n) > 2⁻ᵏ, so it is not in U.

declarations.name: Causal.scaledFan_hasTimeFunction
declarations.standing: T = −X, through ArcCoherent.hasTimeFunction. Along the arc (k, n), X = 2⁻ᵏ ε_n (1 − 2t).

declarations.name: Causal.scaledFan_not_causallyOpenFutureOn
declarations.statement: ∀ {W : Opens scaledFanSet}, scaledFanγ (1, 0) (1 / 2) ∈ W → ¬ scaledFan.CausallyOpenFutureOn W
declarations.standing: Beyond the target. The top y = (0, 0, 1) of the tent (1, 0) is the limit of the tops (0, 0, 1 + ε_m) of level 0. Take V = W ⊓ {Y < X} (scaledFanBelow). J⁺_W(V) holds y: it is reached along its own tent from a point of the rising leg inside W, where Y = X/2 < X. J⁺_W(V) holds no point of level 0: level 0 lies in Y = X (scaledFanγ_zero_snd), and by coherence such a point is reached only along level 0. So J⁺_W(V) is not open.

declarations.name: Causal.scaledFan_le_iff
declarations.statement: scaledFan.le U x y ↔ (x ∈ U ∧ x = y) ∨ arcStep scaledFanγ U x y

findings: No paper is involved: layer 1, no ETT label, nothing marked. Every claim the ladder argues for the loop fan at every scale (programme/ladder.toml, the section comment :5623–5640 and the [[open]] notes :5710–5730) is now a Lean theorem, and none is refuted. GH ∧ CC ∧ ¬ LSC holds on an absolutely minimal (either reading), causally arc-connected, T2, second countable model with a time function. So prop:GH_fortement_causal's tarentin cannot be weakened even to local strong causality (not_locallyStronglyCausal_of_globallyHyperbolic_bare). After the wave-46 records, no pair X → locally_strongly_causal is left open (simulation A).

Beyond the target: the loop fan at every scale is causally open in no form (conjuncts 23–26). The single loop fan is argued causally open (Causal.LscSeparations, SCOPE :76). Stacking the levels on one axis puts the tops of level k ≥ 1 on the vertical segment that level k − 1 accumulates on. At the top (0, 0, 1) of the tent (1, 0), every open W gives a J⁺_W(W ∩ {Y < X}) that holds the top and misses level 0 (scaledFan_not_causallyOpenFutureOn). The witness therefore decides all 21 causality nodes. This moves no pair (simulation C).

The ladder's argument is imprecise in one place. Its 'for U = B(a, ρ), ρ < r/4, a level k with 2⁻ᵏ ∈ (ρ, r/4]' (programme/ladder.toml:5635, repeated in the target's evidence) need not yield a level: for r = 0.9 and ρ = 0.2 the interval (0.2, 0.225] holds no power of 1/2. This is harmless because ρ is ours to choose. The Lean proof picks the level first (2 · 2⁻ᵏ < r, sup metric) and takes U = {Z < 2⁻ᵏ}. The notes' variant, 'a level of height in (ρ, r/2]' (:5710–5730), does contain a level once ρ < r/4.

The carrier is the target's, in coordinates: ℝ³, level k in the vertical plane Y = ε_k X through a, with slope ε_k = 1/(k+1) in place of an angle θ_k (θ_k = arctan ε_k ∈ (0, π/4], distinct modulo π). Each level is a linear copy of the loop fan, (x, y) ↦ 2⁻ᵏ(x, ε_k x, y), not an exact similarity: the plane's own horizontal direction is scaled by 2⁻ᵏ √(1 + ε_k²). The incidences, limits and local picture are the same, and the copies are homeomorphic (argued). The lighter ℝ² carrier with angular sectors would need tents redesigned near a, because the loop fan's feet approach a tangentially to the horizontal; it was not used.

kb_proposals: The loop fan at every scale (Causal.scaledFan on Causal.scaledFanSet ⊆ ℝ³, CausalScaffold.LoopFanEveryScale; T-abs-loop-fan-every-scale) is the ETT-layer witness of globally_hyperbolic, causally_compact ⇏ locally_strongly_causal. Level k is the loop fan carried into the plane Y = ε_k X by (x, y) ↦ 2⁻ᵏ(x, ε_k x, y). Slopes in place of angles keep trigonometry out, and levelEmbed_injective reduces coherence within a level to Causal.loopγ_coherent. Across levels, the vertical holds only tops, whose heights 2⁻ᵏ(1 + ε_n) lie in the disjoint intervals (2⁻ᵏ, 2¹⁻ᵏ]. scaledFan_separates decides all 21 causality nodes. not_locallyStronglyCausal_of_globallyHyperbolic_bare shows that prop:GH_fortement_causal needs tarentin even for local strong causality.

Stacking scaled copies of a witness on a common axis creates new accumulation points: the tops of level k ≥ 1 lie on the segment that level k − 1 accumulates on. Here that kills causal openness in every form, though the single loop fan is argued causally open. The tool is a set that misses a whole level by its plane (V = W ∩ {Y < X}, scaledFan_not_causallyOpenFutureOn). Re-check causal openness and local strong causality away from the accumulation point for any multi-scale witness; neither transfers from one level.
